saw_lines: Home gym buyers compare a mat, band or bench against two or three others, then check delivery before they pay.
So a buyer who wonders about delivery leaves before reading the answer, and the sale is lost in the ad.
Your 2 ads never mention shipping or delivery, though your shipping policy page explains how it ships, so answer delivery in the first line of every new buyer ad.
ads_1: Delivery answered in line one, with the 5 year guarantee as the proof number
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
